# Signature Hair Salon

> A barber shop in Newington, Edinburgh, offering men's haircuts, skin fades, beard trims and hot towel shaves. Open since 2019.

## Business details
- Address: 7 South Clerk Street, Edinburgh, EH8 9JD, United Kingdom
- Phone: 0131 273 8355
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Booking: https://signaturebarber3jpr.setmore.com/book

## Services and prices
- Student haircut - £15
- Men's haircut - £17
- Kids haircut (under 10) - £14
- OAP (over 65) haircut - £14
- All-over, clippers only - £13
- Skin fade - £20
- Zero fade - £18
- Scissors cut - £18
- Men's long haircut - £25
- Beard trim - £10
- Beard trim and line up - £12
- Hot shave and hot towel - £20
